description: Where AI models are served, by country: every known serving site (provider, region, city or facility, live or planned) with its evidence basis (claimed, documented, measured, attested), its source page, a map point (`geo`: lat, lon, precision; `derived` when only the region is known), and the models it serves. Sites whose provider publishes no model list are included with a note. Built from node cards, imported catalogs and curated location seeds. Use it to answer "which providers serve which models in Canada" or "what serves gpt-oss within 500 km of Montréal", or to check a residency requirement before choosing an offering; then search_offerings with `region` to pick one.

availability.description: With a residency filter: count only commitments offered this widely: default (every customer), opt_in (adds settings and regional endpoints), enterprise (adds contract-only offers; the default).

basis.description: Minimum evidence for a site: claimed < documented < measured < attested.

country.description: ISO 3166 code; a country also matches its subdivisions, e.g. "CA" matches "CA-QC". Omit for every country.

exclude_lineage.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes; drops models whose declared lineage includes any of them, e.g. "CN".

model.description: Substring of a model name or artifact, e.g. "gpt-oss" or "command". Keeps only sites serving a match.

near.description: A point as "lat,lon" in decimal degrees, e.g. "45.50,-73.57" for Montréal. Adds distance_km to each site and sorts nearest first.

residency.description: Only sites covered by a residency commitment at least this strong: processing (inference and stored data stay in the area) or storage (data at rest only).

status.description: Only live or only planned sites. Omit for both.

within_km.description: With `near`: only sites within this great-circle distance. Sites known only to the country are excluded, since their point is a placeholder.

name: find_locations
title: Find where models run
